about.heading: AI Skills from Any Source
about.description: Skill Seekers transforms documentation websites, GitHub repositories, PDF files, and local codebases into structured AI skills and RAG-ready knowledge. Create expertise packages for Claude, Gemini, OpenAI, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Cursor, and any LLM platform.

problem.title: The Problem
problem.item1: Building AI skills takes days of preprocessing—scraping, analyzing code, extracting patterns
problem.item2: AI assistants lack deep expertise without manual context preparation
problem.item3: Understanding new codebases requires weeks of manual analysis
problem.item4: Different AI systems need different formats—skills, RAG, coding rules

solution.title: The Solution
solution.item1: One tool for all sources: docs, GitHub repos, PDFs, and local codebases
solution.item2: Deep code analysis detects patterns, architecture, and design decisions
solution.item3: 16 output formats: AI skills, RAG pipelines, coding rules, vector DBs
solution.item4: 15-45 minutes end-to-end: from source to production-ready AI skill

quickstart.title: Get Started in 3 Steps
quickstart.subtitle: From zero to production-ready skill in 20-40 minutes

steps.title: 2. Scrape Docs
steps.description: Use preset configs or create your own
steps.code:
skill-seekers scrape --config react
# Or from URL directly
skill-seekers scrape --url https://react.dev --name react

steps.title: 3. Package & Upload
steps.code:
skill-seekers package output/react/
skill-seekers upload react.zip

# Done! Your skill is ready to use
